title.zh: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position
title.en: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position

current_state.zh: The UK House of Lords voted 194–138 to add an amendment to the Financial Services and Markets Bill requiring the Treasury to publish and consult on a digital asset strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, and tokenized securities within 12 months.
current_state.en: The UK House of Lords voted 194–138 to add an amendment to the Financial Services and Markets Bill requiring the Treasury to publish and consult on a digital asset strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, and tokenized securities within 12 months.
